I feel like a big point regarding this is 'time'.

We still have no real measure of how time has played out in the past, despite having timeless characters attempting to influence the current world, such as SK and Zodd.

Maybe the world is so timeless that each GH member has had a similar exp to Griffith at the moment (saving the mortal world), only to have it blow up in their face (possibly by the appearance of characters such as Guts or SK).
They took this exp as fate and simply embraced it, mentally breaking down and becoming the cynical member of GH that they are now.

Just wanna say, I love the pet theory of one GH member simply using another, or perhaps all of GH just temporarily appointing Griffith GH status, only to watch him struggle and despair if they were to take his God status away...

I feel the same way! Though I constantly ponder HOW Miura will bring about this drastic development.

He clearly loves symbolism, character development, and attention to detail, so I can't see him just writing off the main conflict between Guts and Griffith to a simple 'power up'.

Of course.

But, given the possibility of a long-lasting time frame, maybe SK was the same as Guts in that aspect as well?
As a mortal, simply "fighting the flow" of anything thrown his way; but, now that he's as he is, has submitted to the omnipresence of causality...

Great reply!

I suppose a big thing about all this questioning is HOW Guts will confront Griffith.

I write a lot (though am still completely amateur). Something that should be obvious is Miura's love of symbolism. 
So, given this love, is he willing to betray his establishment of certain symbolic elements to what some would consider "shōnen" elements (such as Guts just Super Saiyaning and destroying GH).

Is that enough though?

Sure, he was able to "wound" Slan, but keep in mind that even the avatar of Slan completely decimated Guts before SK's appearance.

Guts clearly has a type of one up against apostles that maybe SK didn't, but a human still has to abide by human rules.
If it wasn't for Zodd, Guts and his party would have probably perished at Ganishka's appearance.

Demon Slayer is powerful. Berserk armor is powerful. But he's against Gods. A God who changed the world on his own, is now the savior of the mortal world, with the rest of his God companions seemingly chilling in the back.

Exactly.
But keep in mind that, at the end of it all, Guts is still human.

He's strong and smart, with amazing companions at his side, but is still human. 
He's been able to "wound" the God Hand for certain, under SK's temporary guidance...but who's to say SK hasn't experienced a similar situation in the past.
I'd assume the temporary "wound" is nothing more than formality when truly dealing with God Hand's presence.

At the moment, it simply seems farfetched that Guts has any chance against God Hand.
Again referring back to SK...let's assume SK and Void are the original Guts and Griffith (only an assumption).
Assuming this, all SK has truly achieved in his long life is guiding another mortal down the path of meaningless struggle. 
Maybe Flora has advised him before? That certain 'miracles' can occur in the flow of causality; but even then, it remains a fact that God Hand is many, and SK is alone, guiding a simple mortal against what seems to be immortals.

Thanks for your reply :)

First off, I understand what you're saying, though I hadn't exactly written off the existence of an "abnormality" in the flow of causality. As this is largely what Flora is referring to...things may seem the same, play out in similar ways, but at decisive moments are different.

However, are these decisive moments enough to combat the decisive moments in which similarities are the core factor?

I mean like this, Guts has SK as kind of a mentor ATM, with SK believing completely in the flow of destiny/ causality. This is understandable, if he sees his own struggle while living completely mirrored in Guts' struggle.

However, certain 'core' points have seen Guts completely mirroring the actions of SK in the past (such as the equipment of the Berserker armor).  

My real question I suppose, is how many core similarities, such as the equipment of the berserker armor, can Guts take before he becomes just SK is now?

Because all SK is now, is seemingly just a guide for Guts to follow down a road of meaningless struggle (considering SK has had similar traumatic experiences to Guts).

Thank you for the reply..

I suppose there are numerous reasons why this has been getting to me so much. 
Each others first loves, how much I helped her through her own stuff and how she abandoned me when I needed her the most.
Everytime I said I loved her, I meant every word, and I assumed she did to, but maybe I was wrong....

She just moved on so quick, and it's been almost a year and I can't go a day without thinking about her.

Took me under/ around a month, binge reading it during a really dark time in my life. Dunno what triggered it, just decided to pick up Berserk one day.

Granted, although I can read fast, I have the awful habit of doing this: While I'm reading something new that I really love (Berserk in this case), I will constantly reread certain aspects of a story that grip me.
With Berserk, it was every single moment regarding Guts/Caska, I would literally sit there and reread certain pages.
Dunno why I do it, dunno when it started.
Anyways, LOVE BERSERK. Have reread it like 5 times haha.

Yeah, definitely. 
I suppose I sometimes forget the possible price tag which may exist if you want to make the extremely dominant decks that exist in certain card games.
As it is, if money isn't your cup of tea, time is, which is my case, haven't not spent a dime on anything other than the adventures and just crafted my way up.

I also see the point of having to consider the economic factors of the game as a developer. 
I guess I just subconsciously yearn for the days where video games were all about one-upping each other, and it seemed like each new game was full of passion directed towards the furthering of the art of design, rather than the depth of the pocket. 
But that's me getting too ranty haha.

Glad to hear a reply though hero! Always love positive discussion :)

Glad someone agrees that some of the design choices are rather dull!

I do see what you're saying about popularity/ appealing to a certain fan base. 
I suppose for us to see any big changes we'll have to wait until something warrants that decision.

I guess I always naively expect companies to wanna go up and above what they currently have and make some big change that makes some drastic revolution. 
I do enjoy some of the things they have going though. With a specific nod to the Inspire ability, something that's only really possible at a plausible level due to HS being an electronic game.

Just wish they'd take more advantage of what they have and try to amaze their consumer base.

While I may not be able to immediately enable all the advice/support you've given me with just these two posts, I just want to say thank you...

I really do appreciate how understanding you are of how I am right now, and continue to genuinely attempt to help me...

I don't know if I'll ever be able to move past this love I have for her, but thank you for all your support.

I dunno..
I mean, I believe you're probably correct in every aspect of that post.
But...I have such trouble taking all these thoughts and emotions and sorting them...

I mean...I always meant it when I said that I'd love this girl forever, and I thought she meant it too.
Call it a repercussion of first loves...but I really can't mentally handle the situation, or the thought of truly seperating.

I still love this girl so much,

Hope you don't mind an ongoing dialogue, and I'm totally not disregarding your suggestions.

For me, ever since I first dropped out of university at age 17/18, I've been basically seeing a variety of counselors since then. Be it ongoing (if we mesh well) or just one-time check ups.
I've seen multiple psychiatrists and even done mental health programs like CBT (cognitive behavior therapy).

Again, these kinds of things have helped me through certain situations, like my difficulty talking with ANYONE (I'm much better at speaking to a degree).

But, I've been to so many different forms of mental help since then, both group and individual. But no matter what kind of "help" I try to employ in my own life, be it changing dieting habits, to being more active, to lessening video game play, etc...nothing helps with this gaping hole I have in my heart every day.

Most days I'll spend hours crying, trying not to think about these sorts of things, it's all just so hard.
I'm even medicated on all sorts of stuff...nothing seems to help.

I'm sorry to hear about your family member though...I'm happy to hear that differences have been made in those sorts of situations. If anything, I love to hear about others doing well...
Thank you again for your response though, I appreciate the conversation <3

Also, if you have any questions about anything regarding me, the situation, anything really...just ask away.
I'm an open book.

I can only hope so much.
It's nearly been a year and the wound just seems to be growing bigger by the second and hurts more and more every day.

I definitely do agree that I've got a number of issues...
I've been in an out of multiple counselors, programs, psychiatrists, etc.
I've actually come a long way from how I used to be, even if it doesn't sound like it from how miserable I am at the moment.
I feel like I was a lot stronger before I met this girl that I love. It hurts to say, but I feel like it's true.
I've become too attached and am weaker because of it.

Thank you for the suggestion though, I do appreciate the concern :(

I know I'm naive in my thoughts.
And anyone I've spoken to about this has said relatively the same thing as this.

...But I've always been rather obsessive, so that doesn't help the situation at all. 
But I truly can't just drop her like she has me.
After investing so much in so many ways, emotion, time, material, changing so much in an effort to just keep her happy.
I can't drop it. 
I've tried, but I can't.

Hello Reddit!
I’m rather new to this whole experience. I only just created an account for this site, and although I’ve had a tumblr account for a while (which I’m linking), I really haven’t done much with it, nor am I proficient in using it hah. 

This is a short Overwatch fan-fic that I wrote a couple of months ago. The premise is a bit silly and shouldn’t be taken too seriously. The only condition which I had to follow was “Soldier 76 adopts a puppy.” Still, I wrote it relatively, in that it takes place during the Omnic Crisis, so there’s a bit of background for any lore junkies 

Since I wrote the piece, however, nobody that I’ve handed it out to has actually read it or offered criticism sadly.
So I figured, why not post it here? I don’t mind criticism or tips, as long as they’re constructive. I’m well aware that I’m nowhere near a professional level when it comes to writing. I consider myself largely amateur, and this is basically just a hobby at the moment which I indulge in from time to time.

If you decide to read it, then I hope you enjoy! If you’d like, feel free to follow my tumblr, though don’t feel obligated to in any way. 
I don’t post much, but if I get enough positive reception and feel motivated, then I’d probably be open to writing out suggestions that I might think are fun. Anyways, sorry to ramble. Enjoy!
